messages:
leo.newhire: Morning folks, brand-new hire here. Two issues: 1) Okta won't let me enroll the built-in Touch ID on my M1 Mac as a platform authenticator (it gives 'Unsupported authenticator'), and 2) the onboarding Drive alias link opens my personal Google profile instead of my work one. Who do I ping?
tia-it: Welcome @leo_newhire! @it-identity for provisioning. For Touch ID, which browser/version? Platform authn usually works in Safari only.
leo.newhire: I'm on macOS 13.6, using Chrome by habit. Tried Safari and it prompted for Touch ID but then showed 'Unsupported authenticator' after I scanned.
it-identity: Hmm. If Safari is prompting then the browser gesture is okay. Sometimes Okta has a policy requiring 'security key' class (FIDO2 resident key) for the org OU. Can you paste the exact modal text?
leo.newhire: The Okta modal: 'Registration failed: Unsupported authenticator. Contact admin.' No error codes.
maya-devex: Quick checks: 1) Are you enrolled in our Device Enrollment (Apple MDM)? 2) Did you enable Touch ID for web authentication in Safari (System Prefs -> Touch ID -> Allow web authentication)?
leo.newhire: MDM enrollment pending (I accepted device enrollment but the profile install is still in progress). Touch ID is enabled for web authentication.
tia-it: MDM pending could be the key. Some orgs only allow platform authenticators for managed devices. I'll check policy. Meanwhile we can enable an alternative so you don't get blocked.
okta-bot: Okta: Activation email sent to leo@redwood.com at 1790012000.
it-identity: I checked your OU: platform authn is allowed only for devices marked 'Corporate'. For unmanaged devices we enforce security-key-only policy. That explains the 'Unsupported authenticator'. Two options: 1) finish MDM enrollment (preferred) or 2) register a YubiKey/security key as a stopgap. Which do you prefer?
leo.newhire: I can finish MDM now. Also about Drive: the onboarding link opens my personal@gmail account (I have two Chrome profiles). The welcome email doesn't show the Drive shortcut for corp account.
it-identity: For Drive the usual cause is SCIM/gSuite provisioning race + browser profile mix. I pushed a SCIM sync and resent the Drive share to leo@redwood.com. Try in a fresh Safari window (corporate profile) or Incognito and accept the corporate login first.
leo.newhire: MDM enrollment completed and I restarted. Safari registration now asks for Touch ID and Okta accepted it 1 Congrats! Drive link now opens correct account after I signed into corp profile in Safari. I also got the 1Password invite.
onepassword-bot: 1Password: Invite sent to leo@redwood.com at 1790012305.
leo.newhire: One last Q: where should I save the recovery codes for Touch ID (or general MFA backup)? Company policy?
maya-devex: Save recovery codes in the company 1Password vault inside an "MFA Backups" item. If it's a physical key, note storage location but don't upload photos. See #eng-security for required labels.
leo.newhire: Saved codes in company vault and marked item restricted. Thanks all :party_parrot: Closing thread.
